summary: The product is currently available at ₹799, which is the same as its market reference price of ₹799. The M.R.P. is 5.0x the price stores actually charge.

voices.point: Customers praise the sound quality and bass, finding the earbuds awesome.
Users report good call clarity and find the product classy and easy to carry.
Some users experience reliability issues, with one earbud stopping working.
Connectivity problems and Bluetooth pairing difficulties are reported by customers.
Battery life and noise cancellation receive mixed feedback from users.
